decisions.reason: A is a proven, low-uncertainty trommel screen with low retention costs, so its option value remains high and the probability of dropping is very low.
B has maintained a full model line and likely serves the green-waste shredding niche, so its option is still valuable enough to keep with only moderate risk.
C has not shown enough market traction after several years and the ongoing cost of supporting a high-speed grinder line is no longer justified, so the option is abandoned.
F's stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are core to the waste-processing portfolio and low uncertainty supports keeping the option with only a small probability of withdrawal.
